editions.title: This weekend on E-Grid
editions.intro: Four rounds this week across Formula 1, MotoGP, NASCAR and NHRA Drag Racing all converge on Sunday 1 November. Here is what to expect from the Mexico City Grand Prix, the Grand Prix of Malaysia, the Xfinity 500 and the Las Vegas Nationals.

items.headline: Mexico City Grand Prix
items.detail: Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, Mexico · Sun 1 Nov
items.body: The Mexico City Grand Prix runs at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez on Sunday 1 November, with qualifying on Saturday 31 October at 21:00 UTC and the race starting at 20:00 UTC. Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 123 points from George Russell as they arrive here.
facts: Qualifying Sat 31 Oct, 21:00 UTC
Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 123 points from George Russell

items.headline: Grand Prix of Malaysia
items.detail: Petronas Sepang International Circuit, Malaysia · Sun 1 Nov
items.body: The Grand Prix of Malaysia takes place at the Petronas Sepang International Circuit on Sunday 1 November. Marc Marquez leads the championship by 10 points from Jorge Martin as the pair arrive.
facts: Marc Marquez leads the championship by 10 points from Jorge Martin

items.headline: Xfinity 500
items.body: The Xfinity 500 runs at Martinsville Speedway on Sunday 1 November, starting at 19:00 UTC. It covers 500 laps, or 263 miles, with US coverage on NBC and MRN.
facts: 500 laps, 263 miles
US coverage: NBC (TV), MRN (radio)

items.headline: Las Vegas Nationals
items.detail: Las Vegas Motor Speedway · Sun 1 Nov
items.body: The Las Vegas Nationals bring NHRA Drag Racing to the Las Vegas Motor Speedway on Sunday 1 November. With no start time published, details remain to be confirmed.

editions.title: Last week on E-Grid
editions.intro: Three championships decide their weekends in a row on Sunday 25 October: Formula 1 heads to the United States Grand Prix, MotoGP rides out for the Grand Prix of Australia and NASCAR's Cup Series takes Talladega for the YellaWood 500.

items.headline: United States Grand Prix
items.detail: Circuit of the Americas, USA · Sun 25 Oct
items.body: Andrea Kimi Antonelli took the United States Grand Prix from pole, 13.1 seconds clear of Charles Leclerc at the Circuit of the Americas, with Max Verstappen third. A dry, scorching day saw a single stop for the winner and a virtual safety car twice, yet three of the field failed to finish. Antonelli's championship lead over George Russell grew from 102 to 123 points.
facts: Andrea Kimi Antonelli won from pole, 13.1 seconds ahead of Charles Leclerc
Biggest climbers: Gabriel Bortoleto from 21st to 13th and Lance Stroll from 22nd to 15th
Fastest lap: Charles Leclerc, 1:37.976
Did not finish: Valtteri Bottas, Franco Colapinto and Oliver Bearman
Andrea Kimi Antonelli's championship lead over George Russell went from 102 to 123 points over the weekend
Virtual safety car on laps 2 and 51

items.headline: Grand Prix of Australia
items.body: MotoGP reached Phillip Island for the Grand Prix of Australia, round 18 on Sunday 25 October. The Australian round is a long-standing fixture on the calendar as the season builds toward its closing rounds.

items.headline: YellaWood 500
items.body: Kyle Larson won the YellaWood 500 at Talladega from 10th on the grid, holding off teammate William Byron with Ricky Stenhouse Jr third. A razor-thin 0.041-second margin decided a race of 189 laps and 41 lead changes among fifteen drivers under four cautions for eighteen laps. Larson's Chase lead over Denny Hamlin jumped from five to 73 points with two races remaining.
facts: Kyle Larson won from 10th on the grid
Most laps led: Chris Buescher (53)
Stage winners: Stage 1 Chris Buescher, Stage 2 Joey Logano
Margin of victory: 0.041 s
Kyle Larson's Chase lead over Denny Hamlin went from 5 to 73 points this weekend, with 2 races to go

items.body: Andrea Kimi Antonelli took the United States Grand Prix at COTA, winning from pole and holding off Charles Leclerc by 13.1 seconds with Max Verstappen third on a dry afternoon of 27°C air. His championship lead over George Russell grew to 123 points. Gabriel Bortoleto climbed from 21st to 13th as Valtteri Bottas, Franco Colapinto and Oliver Bearman failed to finish.

items.body: Round 18 of the MotoGP season ran at Phillip Island, Australia. Results for this series are not in E-Grid's feeds yet.

items.headline: YellaWood 500
items.body: Kyle Larson won the YellaWood 500 at Talladega from tenth on the grid, edging teammate William Byron by just 0.041 seconds with Ricky Stenhouse Jr third. His Chase lead over Denny Hamlin jumped from five to 73 points with two races remaining. There were 41 lead changes among fifteen drivers across 189 laps as Brad Keselowski, Riley Herbst, Austin Cindric and Erik Jones all failed to finish.

editions.intro: The NASCAR Cup Series has its weekend verdict: Kyle Larson wins at Talladega. Two more rounds stand over the coming days — Formula 1 heads to the Circuit of the Americas and MotoGP to Phillip Island, both on Sunday, with championship leads still to be tested.

items.body: The United States Grand Prix runs on Sunday 25 October at the Circuit of the Americas, starting at 20:00 UTC. Qualifying precedes it on Saturday 24 October at 21:00 UTC. Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 102 points from George Russell.

items.body: The Grand Prix of Australia runs on Sunday 25 October at Phillip Island. The title fight stays wide open with Marc Marquez leading Jorge Martin by just ten points, so this weekend could shift the standings.

lastRaces.headline: Texas FallNationals
lastRaces.body: The Texas FallNationals brought drag racing to the Texas Motorplex in Ennis on Sunday 18 October. Competitors lined up across the season's classes for a weekend of quarter-mile action.

lastRaces.headline: Navarra
lastRaces.detail: Circuito de Navarra, Spain · Sun 18 Oct
lastRaces.body: Round six of the Clio Cup Series ran at the Circuito de Navarra in Spain on Sunday 18 October. Drivers took to the short Spanish circuit for another leg of the championship.

lastRaces.headline: Rally Italia Sardegna
lastRaces.body: World Rally Championship's Rally Italia Sardegna came around Alghero in Italy on Sunday 4 October, forming round 13 of the season. It was another demanding test across Sardinia for the leading crews as they pressed on through the latter half of the calendar.

lastRaces.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
lastRaces.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
lastRaces.body: IMSA's SportsCar Championship reaches its finale with the Motul Petit Le Mans at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta on Saturday 3 October. The endurance marathon has long stood as the series' crowning event, capping another demanding season of sports car racing.

lastRaces.headline: 6 Hours of Fuji
lastRaces.body: The World Endurance Championship turned to Fuji Speedway in Japan on Sunday 27 September for the 6 Hours of Fuji. The circuit's steep climb past the summit has again defined this round, testing drivers and machines across a full endurance distance.

lastRaces.headline: Baku
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: Formula 2 brought its sprint and feature races to the Baku City Circuit in Azerbaijan on Sunday 27 September. The narrow street track threading the old city's walls offered another tight, technical test for the feeder series.

lastRaces.headline: Madrid
lastRaces.body: Formula 3's tenth round came to Madrid, Spain on Sunday 13 September. The championship's Spanish round brought its racing to the city that weekend.

lastRaces.headline: Monza (double-header)
lastRaces.detail: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Italy · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: Autodromo Nazionale Monza has hosted racing since 1922, its 5.793 km lap threading through 11 corners. The Porsche Supercup's seventh round ran here on Sunday 6 September as a double-header in Italy.
facts: 5.793 km lap, 11 corners, first raced 1922

lastRaces.headline: Season Finale
lastRaces.detail: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: IndyCar's season finale reached WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on Sunday 6 September. As the championship's final round of the year, it brought the season to a close at the venue.

lastRaces.headline: London E-Prix
lastRaces.body: Taylor Barnard won in London for DS Penske, completing a Mahindra Racing one-two as Nyck De Vries took second and Edoardo Mortara third. The result leaves Pascal Wehrlein five points clear at the top of the championship, ahead of Jake Dennis.
facts: Pascal Wehrlein leads the championship by 5 points from Jake Dennis
